Ellen — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the PO. Really excited to get Sighnet live.

Quick read: we normally do monthly billing with net-30, but for strategic pilots we can consider deferred/remit structures. Proposed compromise to table with deal desk & finance:
- Phased invoicing: 25% upfront (to cover onboarding), then quarterly invoices for the remainder over 3 quarters
- Payment terms: net-60 on the quarterly invoices (we cannot broadly approve net-90 without exec sign-off)
- Temporary late-fee waiver: waive late fees for the first 12 months of the pilot provided there is an approved PO and no more than one late payment per quarter
- Conditional discount: 7.5% one-year pilot discount (instead of the 10% originally discussed)

I am escalating for approval from Finance & Legal. If we get exec approval for net-60 + late-fee waiver, we can accept the PO and send SOW.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Discount: 7.5% pilot discount is within delegated authority for AEs up to $250k ARR; this deal is near that threshold but okay if legal flags no long-term commitment.
- Waiver: Finance is comfortable with a one-year late-fee waiver if procurement provides a valid PO and we include a clause to reinstate standard fees after pilot or upon second missed payment.

- APPROVE: Phased/quarterly invoicing for the 3-quarter pilot with 25% upfront + 3 quarterly invoices
